aws___get_regional_availability._shape_note: content.result is a map keyed by AWS product name -> {status: str}. The keys are data, not schema, so no TypedDict applies. The tool description states the outer key is products | service_apis | cfn_resources depending on resource_type, so the unwrap deliberately stops at content.result, which is stable across all three.

aws___read_documentation._shape_note: redirected_url and error_code were observed only as null on a successful, non-redirected fetch, so their non-null type is unobserved and stays `Any | None`.

aws___retrieve_skill._shape_note: The unwrapped value is the SKILL.md markdown as a plain string, not a record, so return_model stays null per the no-primitive-name rule; the unwrap still strips the content envelope.

aws___search_documentation._shape_note: Record shape varies with the `topics` argument: doc topics return {rank_order, title, context, url}; topics=['agent_skills'] returns {rank_order, title, skill_description, skill_name}. Both variants were probed and unioned into one total=False model. `topics` is an array, not a top-level scalar, so it is not a codegen discriminator and no variants block applies.
